fields.Name: IT27 - Core Entity Write-Side
fields.Description: Client-first (GraphQL wire) proof of the core data write-side contract — Domain 2 of the integration-test expansion catalog. EW1: create + 2 targeted updates produce exactly 3 Record Changes with the correct Type and before/after ChangesJSON, and the versioning table does not version itself. EW2: a save returns correct VIEW-only virtual-field values (Parent / RootParentID) on both INSERT and UPDATE — no result-column skew. EW3: an AfterKey keyset walk over a known fixture set visits every row exactly once and signals end-of-data with a short page. EW4: AfterKey guardrails refuse StartRow / non-PK OrderBy / wrong-shape keys while the otherwise-identical valid call succeeds (positive control). EW5: a save inside the dedup linger window invalidates the lingered RunView so the next identical view sees the new row. EW6: an UPPERCASE FK saved over the wire is found by both lowercase and uppercase filters. EW7: a non-UTC-offset datetimeoffset survives save → Load → RunView to the millisecond. EW8: a save that passes CLIENT validation is refused by the server-only *EntityServer invariant, proving the resolver instantiated the server subclass. Six of the eight checks mutate and are gated behind RUN_MUTATION_TESTS; the bundle creates and tears down its own throwaway MJ: Action Categories / MJ: Lists rows and never touches a pre-existing record.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Record changes are faithful, virtual fields are captured in the right order, keyset pagination is complete and guarded, saves invalidate lingered views, UUID FKs are case-insensitive, datetimeoffset instants round-trip exactly, and the resolver resolves server entity subclasses.
